description: This Java source file defines an enumeration called DaysInMonthType, which specifies how the number of days in a month should be determined, typically for interest calculation purposes. It includes utility methods for converting between integer values and enum instances, checking if the type is days with 30 days, and retrieving the number of days given a reference date.

classes.name: DaysInMonthType
classes.description: Enumeration representing different ways of handling days in a month for interest calculation: invalid, actual days based on the date, and a fixed 30-day month.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the DaysInMonthType enum constant.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code string associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: integerValues
methods.description: Returns an array of integer values representing all valid DaysInMonthType options, excluding INVALID.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding DaysInMonthType enum, defaulting to INVALID if no match.

methods.name: isDaysInMonth_30
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance corresponds to the 30-day month type.

methods.name: getNumberOfDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days for the month based on the enum type and a reference LocalDate; returns null if reference date is null.
